en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European urban square with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The central façade is long and baroque‑style, with a tiled roof, dormer windows and detailed window frames. On the right side stands a corner building with two onion-domed towers and cupolas. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians are visible in the square in front. The lower part of the image and right side margin are heavily covered with handwritten cursive text. Printed caption text is faint but runs vertically along the right edge and horizontally near the bottom.
